summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. 14/14 backend pytest cases passed against public URL covering: TradingView OANDA spot multi-timeframe (no Yahoo/GC=F), fresh_seconds field & progression on /api/price, new /api/recommendation endpoint, /api/signal/active now includes recommendation with all required fields (action/label/headline/message/urgency/tone), and source code grep confirms all 6 action labels (TOMAR, ESPERAR, MANTENER, TOMAR_GANANCIAS, CERRAR_REVERSO, STOP_LOSS_HIT). Frontend Playwright tests: dashboard-root loads with zero JS errors, RecommendationBanner appears with label='ESPERAR', headline='Mercado neutral · Sin señal activa' and message visible; VoiceSettings card has all 5 controls (toggle, selector, rate, volume, test); voice-toggle correctly alternates ACTIVADAS/DESACTIVADAS; voice-test button enables/disables in sync with toggle; voice-selector includes 'Auto' option (only that option in headless Chromium - expected since no speechSynthesis voices in headless browser); price ticker shows 'tick 15s' freshness indicator; SourceSelector shows TradingView (OANDA) + Gold-API.com (LBMA) with no mention of Yahoo or GC=F.

issues: Recharts emits 2 console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial mount (likely BullsBearsGauge or StrengthBars). Non-blocking, charts render correctly after layout settles. Could be fixed by setting minWidth/minHeight on ResponsiveContainer.

action_items: Optional: silence Recharts 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings by adding minWidth/minHeight to ResponsiveContainer wrappers.
critical_code_review_comments: voice-selector populated only via window.speechSynthesis (Web Speech API) — works on real desktop browsers but headless Chromium has no voices; UI correctly shows 'Cargando voces del navegador…' fallback. Behaviour acceptable per spec.

STATE['ticks'] deque is keyed only on price-changed timestamps via tick buffer; if multiple users hit /api/price simultaneously across processes, fresh_seconds is global (not per-session). OK for single-tenant dashboard.

compute_recommendation evaluates TP1/TP2/TP3 in order — once TP1 is breached the response always says 'TP1 ALCANZADO' even after TP2 because the if-chain checks TP3 first then TP2 then TP1; logic actually correct (TP3 highest hit wins).
ta_cache TTL is 8s while polling is 4-15s on frontend → fine. Indicator data is shared across all timeframes from a single TradingView call which is efficient.
/api/recommendation calls fetch_tv_analysis + get_price every 2s on the frontend — could be optimised but acceptable for now.
seed_data_creation: None - signals self-generate from live TradingView OANDA spot
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses TradingView TA endpoint (https://scanner.tradingview.com/symbol with OANDA:XAUUSD). yfinance/pandas fully removed. fresh_seconds is computed against STATE['last_price_change_at'] global timestamp. Recommendation engine has 6 actions; tone maps to UI colour (buy=emerald, sell=rose, danger=rose ring, success=emerald ring, neutral=zinc). VoiceSettings localStorage key managed by /app/frontend/src/lib/voice.js. Frontend data-testids: dashboard-root, live-price-ticker, recommendation-banner, rec-label, rec-headline, voice-settings, voice-toggle, voice-selector, voice-rate, voice-volume, voice-test, voice-alerts-open, voice-alert-{new_signal,take_now,take_profit,stop_loss,reversal,wait}, source-selector, source-tradingview, source-goldapi, tf-{1m..1d}.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in iteration 2. All requested features (recommendation engine, voice settings UI, fresh_seconds tick buffer, removal of Yahoo/yfinance, new /api/recommendation endpoint) verified working correctly.
